summary: Cowlitz County DNR 40-foot live-in tower built 1963 to replace Elk Rock lookout; removed by a private buyer in 1977; footing and anchor are pictured at the site.

facts.design: 40-foot wooden DNR live-in tower; cab 14 by 14 feet per Willhite, 14 by 13 feet per a 1963 newspaper quote
facts.status_note: Sold to a private party and removed in 1977; Willhite photo captions show a half-buried footing and a lookout anchor

staffing.status: Thomas Huntington (1963), Leland Peterson (1964), Rose Hadaller (1965), Martin Burrows (1967 and 1968); no later staffing in the sources read

access.note: Willhite's route starts on Spirit Lake Memorial Highway; forest roads near the summit are usually gated; the land was Weyerhaeuser's in 1963 and current ownership is not stated

visit.trail_note: No tower remains to climb; Willhite describes getting onto the road network from the Spirit Lake Memorial Highway, where forest roads are usually gated

events.note: Built to replace the Elk Rock lookout, damaged in the 1962 Columbus Day storm
Thomas Huntington of Toutle named as the first lookout person

Rose Hadaller listed as known lookout personnel
Martin Burrows named as lookout again
Sold to a private party and removed, three years before Mount St. Helens erupted

corrections.why: Both the FFLOS and firelookout.com entries give a 40-foot tower, about 12.2 m; 4 m does not match either source

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Willhite gives a 14-by-14-foot cab; a 1963 newspaper quote reprinted by Washington Lookouts gives 14-by-13 feet. The story reports both.
The 1964 Longview Daily News item calls the destination the Gilbert Mountain tower; Willhite places Leland Peterson at Ted Gilbert after Abernathy. Likely the same tower, names differ.

notes_for_editor: Brief lat/lon 46.31443, -122.31223 is about 400 m from firelookout.com's 46.31819, -122.31078; not changed. The 1963 and 1964 newspaper items are reproduced on Washington Lookouts and were not checked against the originals. Current land ownership is not stated in any source read. Willhite photo captions name features but no image URLs were captured, so no photos are listed.
